_comment: Example seed. Copy to seed.json then: node core/src/trust/seed.js. Principal id `owner`. Identifier assistant-web:owner matches ASMLTR_WEB_OWNER_ID=owner so web chat and asmltr ask are not default-deny. No real Discord snowflakes, names, or emails in git. Access cards: default_tier 1–5 (example friend uses 3) may same-guild Discord post; add a discord identifier locally before they can match. Stills/video/code allowlists live in ~/.asmltr/tool-policy.json (see shared/tool-policy.example.json), not here.

principals.notes: Owner of this install. Full trust / bypass_moderation.
Example Access card (tier 1–5). Same-guild Discord post allowed. Not owner. Add a discord identifier (numeric user id) locally before seeding — leave empty in git.
